svg.aria-label: Crow: an agent, not a chat box. Features, tools, images, operating points.
svg.text: An agent, not a chat box.▍
A local model at 200k context with 31 tools and MCP, persistent memory, its own skills,
a browser panel, eyes, and subagents it can send out while it keeps working.
It makes and edits images beside crow-nest's 27B, on one 32 GB card.
Runs on this machine, or on a provider you choose.
crow-nest CNQ4.5-M, RTX 5090, Windows 2026-10-06, after the PLE fix: decode in a live Crow session, prefill cold. Source: docs/operating-points.md
two plain-text stores, per project and per person
procedures the model keeps and rewrites
a plan in the pinned head, it survives a restart
delegate, subtasks, collect: up to 16 at once
tabs and an address bar, render_page for the model
read_image, a drop, a paste; Flash-Next and the 27B
folder, download, size in MB; on the phone too
SQLite FTS5 over every archived conversation
stdio and Streamable HTTP, OAuth, per-tool classes
OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI. Default: this machine
the window on a paired phone, LAN or Tailscale
dictation via faster-whisper, nothing written to disk
a file with an ACL, not an inherited env variable
It asks before it writes, and before it runs.
git_push asks at every level. A path outside the working directory asks first.
31 built in, every MCP tool joins the same list
git_status · git_diff · git_log · git_commit · git_push · github_connect
In the chat an animated square in the theme's colours stands where the picture will be, then turns into it.
RTX 5090; pictures beside the 27B, 40 steps, 2026-09-27/28; the clip: median of 5, 2026-10-02. Source: docs/
‡ live Crow session at 8k, 2026-10-06. * at 122k context, 2026-09-24. — not measured. Dates and sources: docs/operating-points.md
One line, Windows or Linux. Copy it right below this picture.
Preflight, download, a per-file sha256 against the release manifest. No root, no elevation.
One window, Windows or Linux: CrowSetup installs Crow, the engine and the operating points.
